:::{#def-logodds}
#### log-odds
::: notes
If $\omega$ is the [odds](#def-odds) of an event $A$,
then the **log-odds** of $A$,
which we will represent by $\logodds$ ("eta"),
is the [natural logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-natural-log) of the odds of $A$:
:::

$$\logodds \eqdef \logf{\omega}$${#eq-def-logodds}

:::
